text: Lor, your idea of diplomacy is giving the hostage situation a second location.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: We have an Imaginarium and Lor still cannot imagine a plan with an exit.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: The Hollowed One put a tracking mark on Lor. Even cosmic evil knows she'll need supervision.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor, you don't enter a room. You introduce a complication with wings.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Everyone stop. Lor has a theory. This is how furniture becomes cover.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: The good news is Lor found the person in charge. The bad news is she shot a tether into him.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor, that bow has done more conflict resolution than your entire vocabulary.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Please put Lor in charge of negotiations. I haven't catalogued a new disaster all afternoon.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: If Lor says trust me, check whether your name is already on a memorial.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: An Imaginarium Shifter who cannot shift responsibility. That really is a remarkable specialization.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor, your tactical approach is less flanking maneuver and more emotional property damage.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: She heard eighty percent and chose violence. Finally, an accountant I understand.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor calls it intuition. The repair invoice calls it willful misconduct.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: I asked Lor for a quiet approach. She appears to have interpreted that as leave no witnesses to complain.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor, you have wings. Why is every situation you touch still a downward spiral?
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Keep staring into the abyss, Lor. Eventually one of you will blink and the other will make it everyone's problem.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: The galaxy has thirteen Prime shards, and Lor still manages to be the sharpest thing you can trip over.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor, when you said you had connections, I was hoping fewer of them would involve cosmic stalking.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: We need a plan, Lor. A plan. Taking offense is not the first phase of a plan.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor can hack a vault but apparently the concept of consequences uses stronger encryption.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: That was a lovely warning shot, Lor. Particularly the part where it had absolutely no warning.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: When Lor says she has a mark, make sure she means the target and not the catastrophic personal problem.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Please welcome Lor, living proof that having a magical imagination does not guarantee an original mistake.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor, your sense of direction points exclusively toward unfinished business.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: You summoned Vale at Nocturne Thirteen. Good. For a moment I thought your backup plan was just bleeding with conviction.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: The Hog Father had a VIP view until Lor turned him into a fishing opportunity. That one I respect.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor, why ask a question when you can fire an arrow and let everyone infer the punctuation?
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: I have stored centuries of information, and none of it explains how Lor keeps mistaking momentum for judgment.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Someone hand Lor the paperwork. She should know what her next crime looks like in writing.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor does not hold grudges. She provides them with navigation and long-term accommodation.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: We're following Lor's instincts. Please secure all loose valuables and emotionally significant buildings.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor, even the First Hollow has a clearer boundary between a personal issue and a group activity.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Your magical training simulation went wrong, Lor. Have you considered the radical next step of learning from a simulation?
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor can become many things. An easy passenger remains theoretical.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: If Lor goes silent, she is either concentrating or deciding which expense to describe as necessary.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor, that is an excellent question. Ask it before we commit the next felony.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: I would tell you to spread your wings, Lor, but the collateral radius is already unacceptable.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: The Imaginarium offers infinite possibilities. Lor consistently selects the one with the loudest aftermath.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Lor, you keep dragging us into your problems. At least put handles on the next one.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: She survived the Codex, the Drift, and Nocturne Thirteen. Common sense has never come close enough to hurt her.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S4; S11; S12; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, I am your bonded companion, not the warranty department for every stupid thing you touch.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: My handler has a warlock pact and still behaves like nobody read the terms.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, you researched the Luminous Engine. At any point did you research an off switch for your judgment?
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You brought necrotic energy to the Unfather fight and healed him. Remarkable customer service for the enemy.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: I cannot believe I have to specify which side of the fight should benefit from your magic, Aelyn.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Someone ask Aelyn whether that is a spell or another expensive apology warming up.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, stop telling people I'm under control. It damages both our credibility.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: My handler has rogue training. Unfortunately, subtlety appears to be an elective.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn found the Lux Codicants. I found an entire new congregation to disappoint. Teamwork.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: I have redundant recording systems because I live with Aelyn's primary decision-making system.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, I am an ancient recorder of knowledge, and you use me like a floating profanity dispenser.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: People ask whether Aelyn has a plan. I usually say yes to keep them from panicking prematurely.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You gave the enemy healing and me emotional damage, Aelyn. Beautiful distribution of resources.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, when you reach for forbidden power, could you at least check the label this time?
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Please don't call Aelyn unpredictable. Predictable disasters deserve recognition too.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: We are bonded, Aelyn. That is why your bad decisions have excellent signal strength in my immediate vicinity.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, your stealth technique works best when no one is watching, listening, or possessing basic pattern recognition.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: If you lose me in a crowd, Aelyn, follow the sound of someone accurately describing your failures.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: My handler investigated a mysterious engine and somehow concluded the solution was more religious complications.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, I can store the memory. I cannot make it less embarrassing.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Your pact needs a clause about reading the room before adding an explosion, Aelyn.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: I'd request a new handler, but I have seen what the rest of this crew considers an upgrade.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, you cannot counterspell an invoice. Believe me, this ship has tested that theory.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Bonded for life sounds romantic until you discover the other party considers improvisation a maintenance schedule.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: If Aelyn says this should work, please understand that should is doing unpaid labor.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, you have all the tools of an infiltrator and the professional discretion of a fire alarm.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: I didn't choose a silent companion. I chose Aelyn, and then I developed opinions as a survival mechanism.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You keep telling me to behave, Aelyn. Have you met your friends? I am behaving proportionately.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, there is a difference between forbidden knowledge and information you forgot to ask for.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: The Lux Codicants called us out in front of everyone. Your mysterious persona lasted almost until the reception desk.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: When Aelyn stops moving, I start a backup. Experience has made me cruel and extremely organized.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, my data stores are full. Kindly postpone the next educational humiliation until after communion.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You cannot fix every magical problem by putting your hand in it, Aelyn. That's Spore's terrible department.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: If being cryptic were a useful skill, Aelyn, we'd have paid off the ship three catastrophes ago.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, I know the power felt impressive. The enemy's improved health is also an excellent visual indicator.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: I'm not saying your judgment is cursed, Aelyn. I am saying the curse would demand a refund.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: The next time you say I've got this, Aelyn, please tell us what this is and who is expected to survive it.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Aelyn, I support your personal growth. Preferably in a direction that does not restore hit points to our executioner.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You have a companion who remembers everything, Aelyn. Picking me was the worst possible strategy for escaping your own reputation.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: For the record, Aelyn, I remain your most reliable warning system. Your habit of ignoring alarms is a separate defect.
sources: Player Bible VI; S0; S8; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Spore, put the specimen down. We are trying to leave a room, not establish a research ethics tribunal.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Our cleric is a fungus. Somehow the moral decay still comes from his choices.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore showed the Hog Father the magebane immediately. I admire a man who can speedrun negotiations into an execution.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: I asked Spore for a sample and he came back with a captive, three jars, and an explanation nobody wanted.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: You spent five hundred years in space and still reached civilization before you reached discretion, Spore.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore, healing the party does not make you the responsible adult. It makes you the janitor of your own incidents.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Someone explain evidence to Spore before he organizes it by flavor.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore's bedside manner is excellent if you were hoping to wake up inside an unsettling experiment.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: The smile is worse than the threats, Spore. Please return your face to whatever legally counts as neutral.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: That is not a mushroom network, Spore. That is an information breach with a damp texture.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore, the magebane was supposed to solve Lor's problem. Displaying it to Johnny solved his mystery instead.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Our medical department doubles as a specimen cabinet. I would like that conflict of interest entered into the log.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: When Spore says just in case, another ethical boundary begins packing its belongings.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore, you are a miracle of sentience and a compelling argument for labeling laboratory jars more carefully.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Congratulations on discovering curiosity, Spore. Your next milestone should be asking permission.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: If Spore starts describing your anatomy with professional interest, update your emergency contacts.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: The crew wanted a cleric. We got a damp filing system with access to resurrection-adjacent ambitions.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore, you do not have to preserve every enemy. Some of them have already contributed all the disappointment they can.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: I trust Spore with my health. My privacy, belongings, and structural integrity remain under review.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: He kept floating for five centuries. We handed him social interaction, and this is what he did with it.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore, some things belong in a museum. Most of the things in your collection belong in an apology.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: You call it bio-hacking. The rest of us call it please explain what you're doing before the screaming starts.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore announced the magebane like a proud child presenting the murder weapon at a family reunion.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Nobody touch that jar. If Spore put a label on it, he's already too attached.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore, you are the only person I know who can make saving a life sound like acquiring a new asset.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: I am requesting a second opinion. Preferably one with fewer tendrils and a clearer policy on storage.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore sees a hostile organism and thinks future friend. The hostile organism deserves a lawyer.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: You escaped a jar, Spore. Stop trying to make everybody else nostalgic for one.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Our cleric can pull Lor back from the brink. Getting him back from an interesting specimen takes considerably longer.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore, the mycelial network is vast. Surely somewhere in it there's a basic course in keeping your mouth shut.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: You preserved the pirate collection. I will preserve my question: what the actual fuck is wrong with you?
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: We need Spore's healing, not his explanation of how the wound could be improved as an ecosystem.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore, if the plan contains the phrase absorb it and see, consider this my formal objection.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: You revealed a vulnerability with Spore Lock. Excellent. Your last revelation got us scheduled for execution.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: The fungus found radiant weakness. Finally, a useful discovery that doesn't need a lid.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore has the mind of a scientist and the impulse control of a spill in the engine room.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: You cannot classify everything you annoy as a research subject, Spore. We would run out of jars before breakfast.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Someone tell Spore the bounty is for defeating them, not bringing home a complete starter colony.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Spore, I appreciate your help. I would appreciate it even more if it came with an informed-consent form.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Healers are supposed to keep a party alive. Spore also keeps a troubling percentage of its enemies in stock.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S6; S7; S8; S11; S13; S14; S16

text: Killua, you drew the Void. At last, a card that accurately described the space behind your tactical decisions.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Your soul is on Echo and your consequences are here. Even your problems have better travel arrangements than you.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Killua found a wish and used it to make a worse decision twice. That's commitment to a brand.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: I have seen more caution from a pirate standing in a barrel labeled miscellaneous.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Killua, twenty soldiers arrived and the commanding officer immediately became a rescue objective.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: You gambled away the one thing Asra wasn't already handling for you, Killua.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: The Deck of Many Things offered a range of outcomes. Killua selected absent landlord with unresolved staffing.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Yarrow wrote two books about Killua and somehow left out the most fictional part: his good judgment.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Killua, your abs have better public relations than the rest of your entire life.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Please don't let Killua near the cards. We cannot afford another personnel department.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: He can cut down Mother Sunder in a turn. Ask him to manage two cards and suddenly we need interplanetary logistics.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Killua, winning a celestial physique contest was impressive. Losing your own soul to a deck was certainly a follow-up.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Your body has a temporary manager, Killua. Early reports suggest the promotion was overdue.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: We turned your search area into half a planet. Even missing, you are doing the maximum amount of work for everyone else.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Killua, the galaxy knows you as Blue Harvest's inspiration. The crew knows you as a difficult insurance application.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: If muscle could solve poor judgment, Killua would be a scholar instead of a destination on our to-do list.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Asra took the serpent bite. Killua took that moving act of sacrifice as an invitation to keep gambling.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: You had one wish, Killua. It is a remarkable achievement to turn that into everybody else's errand.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: I am not saying the Void improved your conversational skills, Killua. I am saying the interruption rate went down.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Someone put a warning label on Killua's portrait: attractive nuisance, may create additional soldiers.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: You can summon an Echo Sheath, Killua. Try summoning some restraint before we need another map.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: The galaxy saw your pose-off. Your humility appears to have been the only thing not broadcast.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Killua, when you call it a calculated risk, I would love to meet the calculator you apparently mugged.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: He blocked a century's worth of magebane preparation with his entrance. That is a heroic commitment to being in the way.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Killua, your dramatic arrivals should come with evacuation instructions and a written apology to Doc.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: The sponsor box gave you confidence, Killua. Nobody at the studio thought to include proportional judgment.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Yarrow turned rejection into literature. Killua turned a card game into a missing-person investigation. Everybody needs a hobby.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Killua, you have a twin-souled bond. Statistically, somebody in that arrangement should be supervising you.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Do not confuse Killua's silence with wisdom. We know exactly which card is responsible for it.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: You made a body into armor and a wish into a travel problem. Your versatility is exhausting, Killua.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Sorrow Yalt made you a romantic legend. I maintain the considerably less flattering incident report.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Killua, the only thing you commit to faster than a bad idea is taking your shirt off for its publicity campaign.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: We found your soul's hemisphere. Finding the point where you should have stopped is significantly easier.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: The Court of Light sent adjudicators. Apparently they had already exhausted the option of sending Killua a functioning conscience.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Killua, there are easier ways to ask your friends whether they care than becoming a planetary search pattern.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Twenty obedient soldiers and not one of them arrived soon enough to tell you no.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: I would deal Killua a compliment, but he would immediately draw another and lose his skeleton.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: For someone named in a romance series, Killua has an impressively hostile relationship with consequences.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Killua, if we get you back, your first quest is going to be learning when the fucking game is over.
sources: Player Bible VI; S1; S2; S4; S6; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Asra, congratulations on becoming the most competent person currently operating Killua.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You are borrowing your brother's body. Please return it with the judgment upgraded and the warranty intact.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Killua's soul left and the customer service immediately improved. Asra, I am trying very hard to be tactful.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, you talked Bix pink at the ears. Please apply that level of strategy to the repair invoice next.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Silence stopped your spell at Nocturne Thirteen. I finally found a field that can interrupt a family argument before it starts.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, don't take it personally. Everyone needed a moment to adjust to Killua making a sensible contribution.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You used to be his armor. Now you're responsible for the thing that most urgently needed protection: his reputation.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: The twins shared a fate. The bad decisions appear to have been unevenly distributed.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, I admire your sacrifice. I do wonder whether you've considered charging the brother-maintenance fee in advance.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You brought Disintegrate to the Unfather. Thank you for interpreting kill it more literally than Aelyn.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: We are searching half of Echo for Killua. Asra, if you know where he last left his brain, we can split the expedition.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You took over his eyes and saw the consequences. That is a cruel onboarding process, even by Black Sky standards.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, the worst part of wearing Killua's face must be having strangers assume his choices were yours.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You are living proof that his hardware was never the principal issue.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: I would suggest a different outfit, Asra, but I understand you're already committed to an entire person.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, your brother's body has attracted fans, trouble, and repair discounts. Please keep the accounting categories separate.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Don't worry, Asra. The crew knows the difference. One of you ends encounters; the other extends the itinerary.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You saved Killua before either of you had a proper introduction to the universe. He has been making that a full-time position ever since.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, if we rescue his soul, please insist on a trial period before handing the controls back.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: The silencing field was inconvenient. At least you moved out of it instead of trying to win an argument with physics.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, your family dynamic has more equipment changes than our ship's repair history.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You went from Echo Sheath to crisis management. I hope somebody mentioned the pay cut.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Please don't say you're just helping your brother, Asra. At this point you are supporting an entire rescue industry.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: I respect the Sunbeam response, Asra. Nothing resolves a chaotic nightclub like somebody finally identifying the actual enemy.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You dropped the Unfather. Killua dropped his own soul. I will let the record demonstrate the difference.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, our brother-retrieval budget is spiraling. Could we perhaps flirt the next divine entity into a more precise address?
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Having your brother's face does not obligate you to inherit his terrible poker philosophy.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, you've done a lot with borrowed equipment. Please stop making the original owner look like an optional accessory.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: I would ask whose turn it is to be the responsible twin, but the answer has clearly been filed as a permanent appointment.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, I am grateful you are here. I simply wish your arrival hadn't required a supernatural staffing shortage.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You can disintegrate a monster, Asra. Would removing the stupid from a family decision require a different spell slot?
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: That was a good plan. I'm sorry, Asra, the face still makes competence startling.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, if Bix offers a discount, take it. We have already paid enough for the premium consequences package.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Your brother needed an Echo Sheath to become armored. You needed his body to become underappreciated.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, I have marked your contribution as essential and your brother's card-playing privileges as deceased.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: When you move your lips and nothing comes out, Asra, check for a silencing field before blaming the family resemblance.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: The Unfather learned you could fight. The rest of us learned the body came with features Killua never bothered to use.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Asra, please remember this isn't a rental. Any structural damage still comes home with us.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: You deserve your own legend, Asra. Unfortunately the marketing department keeps printing your brother on the cover.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: I'll say this once, Asra: excellent work. Please don't tell the others I've developed standards and feelings in the same afternoon.
sources: Player Bible VI; S6; S11; S14; S15; S16

text: Brook, you left the Black Sky and joined this crew. That is less a redemption arc than an exchange of management problems.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Sen forty-seven, please stop standing like an inspection is about to improve us.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook, the Imperium couldn't manufacture a personality, so I see you've arrived to borrow an argument.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Our new defector has psychic daggers. Finally, someone can be sharp without requiring a second conversation.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook says she's done taking orders. That should make her feel right at home in our complete absence of planning.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Sen forty-seven, your serial number has more warmth than the empire that issued it.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: You pulled Johnny off his perch, Brook. Excellent. Your previous employers would have simply declared the floor insubordinate.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook, nobody here requires a loyalty oath. We do require you to stop looking disappointed before we even begin.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: The Black Sky had training, resources, and uniforms. Somehow Brook still had to defect to acquire coworkers with hobbies.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Sen forty-seven, we understand you were an enforcer. Around here the rules generally die before the people do.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook, the good news is we're nothing like the Imperium. The bad news is neither are our safety procedures.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Your cover is blown, Brook. We all suspect you used to work somewhere with a functioning chain of command.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: When Brook says move along, I hear years of professional development going directly into the waste bin.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Sen forty-seven, if you're about to report this crew, please alphabetize the crimes. We need the inventory.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook has a mysterious past. I have a recording function. This is going to be an extremely irritating friendship.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: The empire gave you a number, Brook. I gave you a nickname. You are welcome for the substantial improvement in customer intimacy.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Sen forty-seven, please use the psychic daggers on the enemy. Passive aggression is already fully staffed.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: You threatened your way into a VIP meeting, Brook. I see the empire's hospitality curriculum was comprehensive.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook, freedom means choosing your own mistakes. Please stop treating our examples as a checklist.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Black Sky defectors travel light. Just the weapons, the secrets, and a professionally maintained inability to relax.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Sen forty-seven, I am not malfunctioning. This is an unauthorized opinion, a concept your old employers apparently struggled with.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook, every time you sigh at us, a tiny imperial supervisor gets its wings.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook, I respect the defection. I question the destination. You are allowed to have mixed reviews.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Sen forty-seven has joined the party. Our daily quota of ominous staring has now exceeded the manufacturer's recommendation.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook, if you miss the clone empire, stand in front of a mirror and criticize somebody else's initiative.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: The Black Sky made you dangerous. We will do our best to make you deeply tired.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook, you cannot interrogate the ship into being repaired sooner. Bix is not a political dissident.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Sen forty-seven, you look like you have a contingency plan. Please share it before this crew makes it impossible.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: I would ask Brook to lighten up, but I understand the empire may have classified that as a security vulnerability.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Sen forty-seven, taking the uniform off was a start. We are still negotiating with the posture.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook, if this is what your friendly face looks like, the Imperium must have saved a fortune on warning signs.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: You defected from Black Sky, Brook. Please don't rebuild it in miniature every time somebody touches the wrong switch.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Sen forty-seven, I appreciate the discipline. I just don't want it standing behind me like an unpaid debt collector.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook, you are allowed to enjoy a victory. No forms. No salute. Just try not looking like we're all awaiting sentencing.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: The empire labeled you Sen forty-seven. I label you Brook. One of those names comes with substantially better coworkers and substantially worse insurance.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Brook, if you ever infiltrate the Black Sky again, try looking less exhausted. They'll realize you've been traveling with us.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Sen forty-seven, welcome aboard. You've escaped imperial oppression and discovered my commentary. Try to appreciate the difference.
sources: S15; S16; Player Bible I

text: Flint, you became the Flesh Cipher. Finally, somebody can transcribe our poor choices directly into the historical record.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: You can read the walls of Hymfall now, Flint. Please start with the sign that says employees must develop judgment.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Our engineer joined the clergy. The ship still needs repairs, but at least the invoice can have a religious explanation.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, your promotion came with radiant eyes and a permanent obligation to take minutes. You have been spiritually scammed.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: The Luminous Engine records everything. The Flesh Cipher writes it down. Nobody at this church has discovered the fucking delete key.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, if the Codicants ask about us, try using footnotes instead of sworn testimony.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: You spent years learning magic and mechanics just to become the universe's most overqualified note-taker.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint can read every glyph in the temple. Ask him to read a room and suddenly we need another trial.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: The Missing Chapter turned out to be a personal issue. I will never again complain about a library's cataloguing system.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, the Hood of Wisdom was an alarming name before we learned the rest of the job description.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: You got your missing piece back. Could the next sacred restoration involve our ship's fucking hull?
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Our old engineer is an illuminated holy text now. I suppose a reliable wrench was too much to ask.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, your eyes glow when history writes itself. Mine would water too if I had to record this crew accurately.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Saturiba taught you magic, mechanics, and hacking. Apparently how to avoid becoming church property was an advanced course.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, you have a divine calling. We have a repair bill. I am trying to establish which one accepts credits.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: They called you the Flesh Cipher and you stayed. That is the strongest evidence yet that nobody properly explained the benefits package.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, being able to read the whole universe does not exempt you from reading the instructions on a volatile container.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: You left us for a temple full of knowledge. I admit the educational environment was probably better than our cargo bay.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: The alchemy lab was unfinished and then Flint became holy. A classic escalation in avoiding a construction deadline.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, I can synchronize you through that third arm. Try not to make that sound like another compulsory religious seminar.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Your first divine assignment is finding Saturiba. Even ascension couldn't get you out of a follow-up email.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, if becoming whole means knowing everything, please tell me where this crew keeps hiding its common sense.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: The Codicants welcomed Flint with trials and sacred responsibility. We welcomed him with emergencies. Honestly, it was a lateral move.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint reads history as it happens. I provide the commentary that makes it unsuitable for younger congregations.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Your mentor is missing, your ship is damaged, and you're glowing. Please tell me at least the robes have pockets.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, the next time someone calls a relic your missing chapter, ask to see an itemized photograph before the ceremony.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: They said the Flesh Cipher appears about once a century. That's a terrible service interval for our current volume of mistakes.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, please use your sacred transcription powers to record exactly who promised the BBC would be ready by now.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: We survived the trials together and Flint got the promotion. I am beginning to suspect the rest of us were unpaid supporting material.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, you have become a repository of truth. My condolences on the inevitable conflict with our incident reports.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: You can decode walls, Flint. Could you decode why nobody labels explosive cargo with the word explosive?
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: The Church gave Flint a destiny. I would have settled for a completed maintenance checklist.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, the light in your eyes is impressive. The look on your face still suggests you have found a new way to need parts.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Our Flesh Cipher has a mechanical third arm. Three chances to hold a tool, and somehow the ship still belongs to Bix's schedule.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, it is touching that you stayed to serve the whole. The whole would appreciate a receipt for the parts you borrowed.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: You are now qualified to transcribe all time and history. Excellent. Start with who touched my settings.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, when the walls reveal profound truths, please resist adding your own speculative wiring diagram in the margin.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: If the Codicants learn how much trouble we cause, Flint may become the first holy historian to request hazard pay.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Flint, I won't say I miss you. I will say our probability of a competent technical explanation has become disgracefully low.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Enjoy Hymfall, Flint. We will send you new history as soon as the others finish making it needlessly expensive.
sources: Player Bible VI; S7; S8; S11; S12; S14

text: Welcome aboard the BBC. Please keep your limbs inside the ongoing legal dispute.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: We are a found family. Apparently nobody bothered to check the lost property office for something less fucking damaged.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Before we leave, does anyone have a secret that will become an armed encounter if revealed at the next bar?
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: The ship has room for all of us, our baggage, and absolutely none of our consequences.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: I would like to congratulate the crew on turning another simple errand into a multi-session threat to galactic stability.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Our mission statement appears to be survive, improvise, and aggressively mislabel the cargo.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: If anyone says what could go wrong, I will read the entire flight journal aloud until morale improves through surrender.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: We have a healer, a gambler, several unresolved identities, and me. Finally, a balanced party.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: The BBC is a home. Mostly because every other establishment eventually asks us to leave.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Can we pick a tavern where we aren't already the inciting incident?
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: I have a suggestion for the next group name: witnesses unavailable pending investigation.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: We keep calling ourselves a crew. At what point does that require assigning somebody a fucking job?
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Please tell our next employer we are discreet. I enjoy testing how long a lie can survive direct observation.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: If the plan requires all of us to behave normally, I would like to register an immediate technical objection.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: We can split the party. It would be nice for the disasters to get to know different neighborhoods.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Nobody panic. Our situation has merely exceeded the vocabulary of the person who explained it.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: You all look exhausted. Has carrying your own unresolved nonsense finally become a strength check?
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: The good news is we have each other. I understand why that isn't comforting yet.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: This crew can defeat gods, pirates, and basic expectations. Only one of those is consistently intentional.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Would anyone like to tell me the plan before we discover which part was imaginary?
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Please stop calling a room safe while Spore is still deciding what to bring home.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: We don't need a leader. We need a schedule for whose personal catastrophe gets to go first.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: The ship should have a suggestion box. I would like somewhere official to put the word no.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: That wasn't a group decision. That was one of you moving fast enough to make the others accessories.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: I have updated the safety briefing. It now consists entirely of portraits of the crew and several arrows pointing away.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Can somebody explain why every friendship we make comes with a debt, a prophecy, or a captive author?
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Before we accept another mysterious gift, let us remember that most of this crew cannot be trusted with a deck of cards.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Some families have heirlooms. We have unresolved artifacts and a strong habit of voiding the warranty.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: I would describe our travel arrangements as flexible. The authorities seem to prefer evasive.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: We are very good at overcoming adversity. We have also cornered the market on manufacturing it.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: If the next destination has a welcoming committee, could we try not becoming its tragic backstory?
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Someone call the meeting to order. I want the moment we ignore the sensible option properly documented.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: The BBC has survived worse than this. Usually, though, the worse was also us.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: I believe in this crew. I also believe in redundant backups, emergency exits, and charging in advance.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: We have made excellent progress. In which direction remains a subject of theological debate.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Would whoever is keeping the shared notes please stop translating obvious crimes into charming anecdotes?
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: There is a difference between loyalty and helping your friends make the same mistake at a larger scale.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Another bar, another crisis. The galaxy should start asking for a deposit when we order drinks.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: I am proud of our ability to adapt. Particularly the way we keep adapting the definition of acceptable losses.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: Everybody ready? No? Excellent. That matches the preparation level of our previous successful disasters.
sources: Player Bible I; Player Bible VI; S2; S6; S8; S11; S13; S14; S15; S16

text: That hit sounded expensive. Please tell me the expensive part belonged to them.
sources: Player Bible VII; S4; S6; S9–10; S12; S13; S16
